# `vox-repository`

**Crate:** `vox-repository` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Repository discovery, stable identity, layout probes, and agent scope helpers for external and internal Vox workspaces

## Crate Overview

Discover the logical repository root (Git work tree or fallback), compute a stable
[`RepositoryContext::repository_id`], and probe stack capabilities for MCP/orchestrator wiring.
